description:
SEE CAPTION FOR HOW IT WORKS ⬇️

Share this with someone who needs it ❤️

Most of your suffering is created by the voice in your head 💔

When you ask, “ I wonder Who my mind is actually talking to?”, your brain does something extraordinary. ⭐️

It pauses the Default Mode Network — the region that fuels your ego, creates your self-story — and for a moment, the noise stops.
You experience pure awareness.

The more you explore this question, the more your brain learns to quiet the overthinking circuits automatically.
Anxiety fades. Clarity returns and you begin to experience your natural state of being thats been hidden by the noise of your distracted mind.

This will change your life in ways you cannot imagine.

Try it now — then comment what you experienced and how it felt.

But don’t stop there. Keep it going for your own deeper insights.

If you are fed up with struggling with your mindset, please reach out. Check out the ultimate mindset change podcast  and community too.  Link in bio ❤️

#anxiety #stress #spiritual #mindfulness #negativethoughts #successmindset
transcript: Here's how I can instantly stop any type of negative thinking and clear my mind in just a few seconds. It's crazy how well this can work. If you want to give this a go, do this with me right now. Direct your attention to inside your mind. Be gentle with this, but allow for any negative thoughts and narratives about yourself or life to arise to the surface. As they begin to appear, ask this powerful question and then observe what happens next. I wonder who my mind is actually talking to keep repeating the exercise what do you experience let me know below in the comments
